thread:
Anya: quick heads-up — on the magnetX13b-int8 bringup I keep seeing a KV cache divergence after ~8k tokens when we prefill with a long system prompt. Repro is consistent on GPU. Suspect RoPE/rescale handling during warmstart.

Mike: can you paste the run command + a tiny log snippet? do we have a minimal reproducer? :eyes:

Anya: running with the dedicated bucket, command:```python3 run_infer.py --model magnetX13b-int8 --prefill-file tests/long_prefill.txt --prefill-tokens 9000 --warmstart true --save-kv /tmp/kvdump```log excerpt:```[2026-03-18 14:02:13] prefill=9000 tokens, kv_len=9000
[2026-03-18 14:02:13] kv_write idx=8191 -> key=0x1a3f...
[2026-03-18 14:02:13] kv_read idx=8191 -> key=0x1b4c...  # mismatch
[2026-03-18 14:02:13] divergence detected at token 8192
```

Sasha: interesting — the boundary at 8192 stands out (power-of-two fence). could be a fencepost with our block-tiling or a rotary-phase rescale that only flips when sequence >= 8192. did you try disabling the rescale shim (`--no-rope-rescale`)?

Anya: not yet. I ran a quick variant toggling `KV_CACHE_SHRINK=1` and saw the same mismatch, but when forcing `--prefill-tokens 8190` the issue vanishes. that makes me think of an off-by-one in the windowing/tiling code that only triggers on >= 8192.

Dmitri: reassigning to kernel + kv teams: my hypothesis — when prefill crosses the block boundary we switch to a different memory layout (compact tiling) and the rotary index mapping routine doesn't adjust the offset correctly for quantized weights. steps to bisect: 1) reproduce with `--trace-kv-index` to dump indices, 2) run same prefill with float32 model, 3) run with `--no-tiling` if available. if float32 is fine -> quant path bug.

Anya: quick matrix I ran: 
- magnetX13b float32 @9000 => no divergence
- magnetX13b int8  @9000 => divergence at 8192
- magnetX13b int8  @8190 => no divergence
so seems quantized codepath + threshold.

Mike: can you push the minimal reproducer harness to a branch and include the kv dumps (redact PII) + cmdline? i'll kick off a nightly job with extra diag flags and ping kernel folks. also add a short test in tests/kv_regress/ that reproduces deterministically so CI can catch it. :thumbsup:

Anya: created branch `eng-ml/kv-8192-repro`, pushed `tests/kv_regress/rep-8192.py` and attached a small sample kvdump.gz (first 200KB) to the PR. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/rlib/pull/4287 (logs + reproducer).

Sasha: nice. small suggestion — add a tiny harness that alternates `ropexact` vs `ropeinterp` codepath if we have both, so we can confirm whether rescaling implementation is root cause. also include `--seed 42` for deterministic decoding.

Dmitri: I'll run a kernel-level trace tomorrow against the PR. if we see index mapping mismatch, patch will likely be a single-line offset fix in `kv_tile_index()` when tiling across block boundaries.

eva-bot: CI/job `eng-ml/kv-8192-diagnostics` triggered by Mike — job id 99234. Logs will be available in ~30m.

Mike: action items: Anya to attach the full kvdump + minimal script (done), Sasha to add ropexact toggle in harness, Dmitri to run kernel trace and comment on PR, me to wire green CI gate. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Anya: ack — I'll also try an int4 snapshot quickly to see if lower-precision exacerbates or hides the symptom. will post results.

Sasha: if you want a quick local check:```python3 tests/kv_regress/rep-8192.py --model magnetX13b-int8 --prefill 9000 --toggle-rope rescale,exact --out /tmp/rep.out```should be quick on a dev GPU.

Mike: thanks all. if anyone hits the reproducer please comment on the PR instead of creating new threads so we keep all artifacts in one place. :calendar:

Dmitri: preliminary kernel trace outcome (posting after I run tomorrow) — but if it's what I expect, it's a tiny index calculation bug and we can hotfix on dedicated immediately.

Anya: posted an intermediate update: int4 repro also diverges at 8192 but with different mismatch pattern — suggests mapping layer before quant rounding. filing this under "likely position-to-rotary mapping".

Sasha: :eyes: keep us posted. good catch, Anya.

Mike: closing loop — assigned task ENG-ML-2193 to follow to completion. will mark as high priority until a fix lands.

Anya: thanks — will update PR with any further traces.
